Detailed Description

POSIX Message Passing option (feature-test macro).

When defined, indicates that message queue support is available. The mq_*() APIs are documented under this option.

Typedef Documentation

◆ mqd_t

typedef int mqd_t

Message queue descriptor returned by mq_open().

A message queue descriptor is a file descriptor; the access mode and O_NONBLOCK are per-descriptor state, as for any other open file description.
